newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-THIEVES STEAL BELGIAN PLAYER OF YEAR AWARD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-THIEVES STEAL BELGIAN PLAYER OF YEAR AWARD.

text.p: Thieves stole Club Brugge captain Franky Van der Elst's Belgian player of the year award hours after it was presented to him.
Van der Elst left the "Golden Boot" trophy in his car on Wednesday while he went for a celebratory drink.
"It's not really bad in itself, but I'm a bit embarrassed," he was quoted as saying in Friday's La Derniere Heure newspaper.
